_note: NoöPunk base system, revision wn-2d6-cwn. Author direction 2026-10-26: 'For beginning, use CWN/SWN/AWN/WWN system for everything. Make the stats, skills, all rules based on them. We will modify later.' These values are the CWN SRD (CC0) facts written as data: six attributes 3-18 with the modifier band, skills level-0..4 with -1 untrained, skill checks 2d6 + attribute modifier + skill level vs a 6/8/10/12/14 ladder, and 1d20 saving throws with a 16-minus-level-minus-modifier target. The implementation in src/rules/wn.py is original expression over these facts; the SRD wording is not reproduced.
_source_of_truth: Cities Without Number System Reference Document v1.0 (CC0) sections 1.01 Attributes, 1.02 Skills, 2.02 Saving Throws, 2.03 Skill Checks. Verified 2026-10-26 against the published SRD. Stars Without Number and Ashes Without Number share the shape; no text from them is used because no SRD licence is established for either.
_status: base system for new play; the legacy 1d10 layer is transitional (see docs/rules/WN_BASE_SYSTEM.md)

generation.method: 3d6 in order, one score may be replaced with 14 before final touches
generation.array_note: an array may be assigned freely, but then no 14 substitution is allowed

skills._note: level-0 is basic competence; the first pick makes a skill level-0. Starting characters cannot exceed level-1.

skill_check.failure: an outright failure, bad luck, or success at a cost the referee names

difficulties.6: simple; anything easier is not worth a check
difficulties.8: a significant challenge to a competent professional
difficulties.10: skilled-expert work; even an expert may fail
difficulties.14: only a true master has any chance

aid_bonus._note: an aider checks against the same difficulty; failure costs nothing

saves.formula: 16 - level - the highest of the two listed attribute modifiers

mental.resists: cyberware intrusion, psychotropic influence, psychological trauma

luck._note: no attribute modifiers; target is 16 - level
